feature.name: CommonMark block/inline parsing and HTML rendering
feature.description: Extract markdown-it-py's MarkdownIt parser and renderer for CommonMark-compatible HTML output.
included_behaviors: render headings, paragraphs, emphasis, lists, blockquotes, links, images, code spans, and fenced code blocks
escape raw text correctly in rendered HTML
parse Markdown into Token objects with nesting, tags, attrs, content, and markup
support the commonmark preset and enable/disable rules
excluded_behaviors: plugin ecosystem beyond core parser rules

entanglement.description: CommonMark rendering is coupled to block/inline parser rules, token trees, renderer state, and escaping behavior.

public_spec.title: CommonMark block/inline parsing and HTML rendering
public_spec.summary: Extract a task-scoped subset of `markdown_it` into a standalone `featurelifted` package.

required_api.signature: (config: 'str | Mapping' = 'commonmark', options_update: 'Mapping | None' = None, *, renderer_cls: 'Callable[[MarkdownIt], RendererProtocol]' = <class 'RendererHTML'>)

behaviors.text: The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: render headings, paragraphs, emphasis, lists, blockquotes, links, images, code spans, and fenced code blocks. Required observable cases include nested blocks code escaping and images; strikethrough and reference links.

The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: escape raw text correctly in rendered HTML. Required observable cases include commonmark basic html rendering; strikethrough and reference links.

The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: parse Markdown into Token objects with nesting, tags, attrs, content, and markup. Required observable cases include parse returns useful tokens; strikethrough and reference links.
The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: support the commonmark preset and enable/disable rules. Required observable cases include fence rule disable and link attributes.

The package exposes the required task API paths `featurelifted.MarkdownIt`, `featurelifted.MarkdownIt.render`, `featurelifted.MarkdownIt.disable`, `featurelifted.MarkdownIt.enable`, `featurelifted.MarkdownIt.parse` with the kinds and callable signatures listed in this contract.

exclusions: plugin ecosystem beyond core parser rules
